# MainTech Appliance Repairs
# Website: https://www.maintechappliancerepairs.co.za
# Last Updated: 2026-10-25

## Company

MainTech Appliance Repairs repairs home appliances at the customer's home across Gauteng, South Africa. A technician visits, finds the fault, explains it and the repair before any work starts, and tests the appliance after the repair. If a repair does not make sense for an older appliance, MainTech says so.

- Phone: 065 650 8504
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/27656508504
- Email: info@maintechappliancerepairs.co.za
- Service region: Gauteng (no public street address)
